faq_heading: New construction in Maple Ridge: your questions answered

faq.q: What counts as new construction on this page?
faq.a: Active MLS® listings in Maple Ridge where the board's age field is 0 or less: homes finished this year and homes listed before completion, in houses, townhomes and condos.

faq.q: Where are the newest homes in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Over the past year the newest sold homes were townhomes in Silver Valley: median build year 2017, 24 sales, median price $805,000.

faq.q: How fast do newer homes sell in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The quickest group among the newer ones was townhomes in Silver Valley: 18 days to sell at a median, closing at 98.8% of the list price.

blocks.text: The search above shows active Maple Ridge listings that the MLS® records with an age of 0 or less. That picks up homes completed this year and homes listed before completion, in three types (houses, townhomes and condos), with land and income properties left out. The MLS® carries only part of the new-home market: developers sell many presale homes directly and list them late.
What newer homes in Maple Ridge have sold for
Silver Valley led Maple Ridge for newness over November 2025 to October 2026. Townhomes that sold there had a median build year of 2017 (24 sales, median price $805,000).

None of the 20 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later, so most of what sold was older stock; newer homes here are mostly first sales that never reach the resale shelf.

items.t: Silver Valley townhomes: 24 sold at a median of $805,000 (middle half between $756,250 and $879,900), taking 18 days at 98.8% of the list price, with a median build year of 2017. The typical home had 3 bedrooms, it sold for about $510 per square foot, strata fees were a median $367 a month and 0% of the sales closed over the list price.

In Albion, the 29 townhomes that sold had a median build year of 2016 and a median price of $745,000; the middle half closed between $699,900 and $800,500, after 22 days on the market at 98.2% of list. The typical home had 3 bedrooms, it sold for about $525 per square foot, strata fees were a median $318 a month and 3% of the sales closed over the list price. The median held near $704,900 from the first quarter to the last.

98 condos sold in West Central at a median $445,950, built 2015 at the median. They took 26 days and closed at 97.7% of the list price, with the middle half between $390,000 and $515,000. The median moved from $457,000 (November to January) to $468,950 (August to October).

blocks.text: Maple Ridge overall: what sold over the past year

items.t: Across Maple Ridge, 478 houses sold at a median of $1,174,950, with the middle half between $1,000,000 and $1,350,000. They took 23 days and closed at 97.2% of the list price, and the median build year was 1993. The typical house sat on a lot of about 6,372 square feet. The median moved from $1,180,000 (November to January) to $1,070,000 (August to October).

Maple Ridge townhomes over the past year: 273 sales, a median of $715,000, and a middle half from $634,500 to $780,000. The median home was built in 2010, took 25 days to sell and closed at 98.0% of list. Strata fees were a median $393 a month. The median moved from $720,875 (November to January) to $698,444 (August to October).

Across Maple Ridge, 220 condos sold at a median of $466,000, with the middle half between $394,250 and $535,000. They took 28 days and closed at 97.5% of the list price, and the median build year was 2009. Strata fees were a median $373 a month. The median moved from $479,900 (November to January) to $455,000 (August to October).

Maple Ridge duplexes over the past year: 8 sales, a median of $1,087,000, and a middle half from $927,425 to $1,095,000. The median home was built in 2026, took 48 days to sell and closed at 99.6% of list.
